package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
)

func assessmentTranslations() []TaskTestI18n {
	return []TaskTestI18n{{I18nID: 1, Title: "Question"}}
}

func variantTranslations(text string) []TaskTestVariantI18n {
	return []TaskTestVariantI18n{{I18nID: 1, Text: text}}
}

func TestValidateTaskAssessmentsOrdering(t *testing.T) {
	one, two, three := 1, 2, 3
	tests := []TaskTest{{
		Kind:         TaskTestKindOrdering,
		Order:        1,
		Translations: assessmentTranslations(),
		Variants: []TaskTestVariant{
			{Order: 1, CorrectOrder: &two, Translations: variantTranslations("Second")},
			{Order: 2, CorrectOrder: &one, Translations: variantTranslations("First")},
			{Order: 3, CorrectOrder: &three, Translations: variantTranslations("Third")},
		},
	}}

	if err := ValidateTaskAssessments(tests, 0, TaskTestKindOrdering); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid ordering assessment rejected: %v", err)
	}

	tests[0].Variants[2].CorrectOrder = &two
	if err := ValidateTaskAssessments(tests, 0, TaskTestKindOrdering); !errors.Is(err, ErrConflict) {
		t.Fatalf("expected duplicate correct order conflict, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskAssessmentsClassification(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []TaskTest{{
		Kind:         TaskTestKindClassification,
		Order:        1,
		Translations: assessmentTranslations(),
		Groups: []TaskTestGroup{
			{ID: "group-a", SourceKey: "question.group-a", Order: 1, Translations: []TaskTestGroupI18n{{I18nID: 1, Title: "A"}}},
			{ID: "group-b", SourceKey: "question.group-b", Order: 2, Translations: []TaskTestGroupI18n{{I18nID: 1, Title: "B"}}},
		},
		Variants: []TaskTestVariant{
			{Order: 1, GroupSourceKey: "question.group-a", Translations: variantTranslations("Item A")},
			{Order: 2, GroupID: "group-b", Translations: variantTranslations("Item B")},
		},
	}}

	if err := ValidateTaskAssessments(tests, 0, TaskTestKindClassification); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid classification assessment rejected: %v", err)
	}

	tests[0].Variants[0].GroupID = "group-b"
	if err := ValidateTaskAssessments(tests, 0, TaskTestKindClassification); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected mismatched group references validation error, got %v", err)
	}
	tests[0].Variants[0].GroupID = ""

	tests[0].Variants[1].GroupID = "missing"
	if err := ValidateTaskAssessments(tests, 0, TaskTestKindClassification); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected unknown group validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateTaskAssessmentsDoesNotCoerceKinds(t *testing.T) {
	one := 1
	tests := []TaskTest{{
		Kind:         TaskTestKindOrdering,
		Order:        1,
		Translations: assessmentTranslations(),
		Variants: []TaskTestVariant{
			{Order: 1, CorrectOrder: &one, Translations: variantTranslations("One")},
			{Order: 2, CorrectOrder: &one, Translations: variantTranslations("Two")},
		},
	}}

	if err := ValidateTaskAssessments(tests, 0, TaskTestKindSingleChoice); !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected kind mismatch validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestStructuredAssessmentTaskContracts(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name          string
		taskType      int16
		kind          string
		structureCode string
	}{
		{name: "ordering", taskType: TaskTypeOrdering, kind: TaskTestKindOrdering, structureCode: CodeStructureTypeTestOrderingBasic},
		{name: "classification", taskType: TaskTypeClassification, kind: TaskTestKindClassification, structureCode: CodeStructureTypeTestClassificationBasic},
	}

	for _, test := range cases {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			parsed, err := ParseTaskType(test.name)
			if err != nil || parsed != test.taskType {
				t.Fatalf("ParseTaskType(%q) = %d, %v", test.name, parsed, err)
			}
			if TaskTypeName(test.taskType) != test.name {
				t.Fatalf("TaskTypeName(%d) = %q", test.taskType, TaskTypeName(test.taskType))
			}
			if TaskAssessmentKind(test.taskType) != test.kind {
				t.Fatalf("TaskAssessmentKind(%d) = %q", test.taskType, TaskAssessmentKind(test.taskType))
			}
			if TaskAssessmentCodeStructureType(test.taskType) != test.structureCode {
				t.Fatalf("TaskAssessmentCodeStructureType(%d) = %q", test.taskType, TaskAssessmentCodeStructureType(test.taskType))
			}
			caps := defaultTaskCapabilitiesByType(test.taskType)
			if caps.ExecutionMode != TaskExecutionModeNoRun || caps.SubmissionMode != TaskSubmissionModeAnswerPayload || caps.RequiresSandbox {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected assessment capabilities: %+v", caps)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestAssessmentPurposeDefaultsAndRejectsUnknown(t *testing.T) {
	if got, err := NormalizeAssessmentPurpose(""); err != nil || got != AssessmentPurposeKnowledgeCheck {
		t.Fatalf("empty purpose should default to knowledge_check: %q %v", got, err)
	}
	if got, err := NormalizeAssessmentPurpose(" DIAGNOSTIC "); err != nil || got != AssessmentPurposeDiagnostic {
		t.Fatalf("diagnostic purpose was not normalized: %q %v", got, err)
	}
	if _, err := NormalizeAssessmentPurpose("exam"); err != ErrValidation {
		t.Fatalf("unknown purpose should be rejected: %v", err)
	}
}
